title: WorkPulse attendance.checked_in v1
description: An attendance record was opened by a check-in. Server-side facts only — no notes, names or client-supplied times (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the record belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

workday.description: Calendar date of the check-in in the employee's location timezone.

work_mode.description: Where the employee is working — the board counts the modes separately.

late.description: Lateness flag set once at check-in and never cleared.
